about: Public-features survey of 35 AI-news, paper-discovery and feed-reading apps, compared with this project. Each feature claim comes from the app's public pages, documentation, published papers or independent reviews, with the URL in `source`; nothing was decompiled, nothing was scraped from behind a login, and notes are written in our own words (no copied text). `has`: true, "partial" or false (false only when absence was confirmed); a missing feature key means not found or not verified. No person's claims are recorded, and no Twitter/X data was used. Our own column (`ours`) was checked against the code; see docs/PARITY.md.

ingest_feeds.evidence: RSS/Atom and JSON Feed parsers (`FORMATS` in lib/feeds.js); scheduled harvest in lib/harvest.js

ingest_arxiv.evidence: `arxiv`, `hf-daily` and `semantic-scholar` formats in lib/feeds.js; daily paper watch scripts/watch.js (extended)

custom_sources.evidence: admin adds sources, enables catalog entries and imports OPML (POST /api/admin/sources, /api/admin/catalog/enable, /api/admin/opml in modules/admin/routes.js); readers suggest feeds into a pending queue (POST /api/sources/suggest, server.js, extended)

no_feed_sites.evidence: POST /api/admin/sources/discover finds feed links on a page (`discoverFeeds` in lib/feeds.js) and two search APIs act as feeds (`hn-algolia`, `semantic-scholar`); no HTML-to-feed scraping rules

clustering.evidence: `storyKeys` (arXiv id, normalised URL, normalised title) in lib/feeds.js; `addItem` in lib/harvest.js; there is no read state to carry across a group

topic_tagging.evidence: lib/tagger.js against lib/ontology.json, matched words shown (REQ-005)

explainable_ranking.evidence: 0-100 significance with a reason per point (lib/analysis.js); feed rank formula in `storyRows` (server.js)

personalization.evidence: sorts are top, new, votes and signal only (GET /api/stories, server.js); GET /api/knowledge/similar ranks by a typed query, not by the reader's history

search.evidence: `q` on GET /api/stories is a substring LIKE over title and summary (server.js), wired to the search box in public/index.html; embedding similarity at GET /api/knowledge/similar (extended); no full-text index, tags or matched words not searched

filters.evidence: topic, source kind, organisation, `tag=` (topic/org/benchmark/person), days, minimum significance and saved-only on GET /api/stories (server.js); no mute or negative filters

saves_lists.evidence: POST /api/stories/:id/save (server.js); reading lists with follow, /api/lists and public/lists.html (extended)

notes_highlights.evidence: private or public notes per story, POST /api/stories/:id/notes (server.js, extended); no highlights

votes.evidence: one toggle vote per user per story, POST /api/stories/:id/vote (server.js); single axis

comments.evidence: public notes are shown to every reader on the story page and counted on cards (server.js, public/story.html, extended); no replies or threads

moderation_antigaming.evidence: admin hides stories and disables users (PUT /api/admin/stories/:id, /api/admin/users/:id), rate limits on sign-up, login, submit and suggest (`limit` in server.js), suggestions queued as pending, Review desk guards (modules/review); votes have no rate limit or weighting

paper_summaries.evidence: feed summary stored (capped, REQ-007); dossiers and explainers (modules/review/dossier.js, modules/learn, extended); no generated per-item summary

claim_evidence.evidence: Review desk rigor, hype and credibility judges and bands (modules/review/review.js, bands.js, extended)

citation_graph.evidence: concept graph and knowledge graph (GET /api/knowledge/graph, /m/map, extended); `semantic-scholar` is a search feed only; no citation graph

alerts_digests.evidence: weekly brief in the app (GET /api/brief, public/brief.html, extended); RSS of published Learn posts only (GET /api/learn/feed.xml); no story feeds out, no email, no 'since last visit'

coverage_comparison.evidence: story page 'covered by' table lists each source's name, kind and link (public/story.html); independent-source count lifts rank (server.js); `story_links.seen_at` is stored but not shown; no single-source list

source_credibility.evidence: every source has a kind, shown on cards (`KIND` in public/js/api.js), and the kind sets the evidence level that scores points (`EVIDENCE` in lib/analysis.js: peer-reviewed, independent evaluation, lab, preprint, policy, news, commentary, community); no per-source primary/secondary or vendor/independent label

export_api.evidence: admin OPML export and import (GET/POST /api/admin/opml); JSON-LD export of the knowledge layer (GET /api/knowledge/export.jsonld, signed in); the JSON API needs sign-in; no export of a reader's own saves, lists and notes

minimal_accounts.evidence: username and password only, scrypt hashes, 30-day session cookie (server.js, REQ-009..012); tracking parameters stripped from links (`normUrl` in lib/feeds.js)

mobile_offline.evidence: phone layout with no sideways scroll (public/css/app.css, REQ-018); no web app manifest or service worker

accessibility.evidence: labelled search, tabs with roles and `aria-selected`, alerts with `role=alert` (public/index.html, modules/admin/pages/admin.html); no keyboard shortcuts, no audit recorded

open_source.evidence: public GitHub repo; package.json says ISC but there is no LICENSE file

free_tier.evidence: Vercel Hobby and Neon Free, daily cron (vercel.json, docs/DEPLOY.md)

ai_features.evidence: Learn studio jobs run by a local worker (scripts/learn-worker.js), judges with no model calls; no paid calls by default

reproducibility.evidence: Lab paper-to-code toys (modules/lab/papers.js, extended); the `hf-daily` parser keeps title, summary and date only, research write-ups retain the first repository URL; broad artifact extraction remains incomplete

forecasting_metrics.evidence: benchmark mentions with values in `story_entities`; capability tracker with highest reported score (GET /api/capabilities, extended); research forecast events and Brier scores from explicit probabilities (modules/review/sources.js)

admin_sources.evidence: /m/admin: sources, catalog, discovery, test fetch, harvest runs, users, story moderation, ontology, re-tag, audit log (modules/admin)

analytics.evidence: capability tracker: activity per area this window against the last (GET /api/capabilities, /m/capabilities, extended); admin overview counts (GET /api/admin/overview); brief compares topics with the week before

transparency.evidence: admin audit log of who changed what (lib/audit.js, GET /api/admin/audit), admin-only; score reasons on every story; no public log of rule or ontology changes
